## Why visit

A particularly appealing November stop: a Georgian former merchant’s house with fireplaces, several drinking spaces and an operator that explicitly puts cask, stout and pies at the centre of the offer. Its current Irish-pub-inspired presentation followed a 2024 refurbishment, so appreciate the surviving building and the newer pub design on their own terms. It provides a comfortable alternative to the larger Seel Street conversion nearby and gives a Ropewalks walk a good fireside pause. The outdoor areas are a bonus, but the interior is the principal reason to visit in this season.

## Beer

The official website advertises a broad cask-ale and stout selection; CAMRA confirms cask. Ask which stouts are cask rather than assuming all are.
